privacyPolicy.txt1: Welcome to our Privacy Policy. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our application.
privacyPolicy.txt3: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, submit a request, or communicate with customer support. This may include your name, email, phone number, and other relevant details.
privacyPolicy.txt5: We use the collected information to provide, improve, and personalize our services. This includes processing transactions, sending notifications, ensuring security, and analyzing usage trends.
privacyPolicy.txt7: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share data with trusted service providers for necessary operations, complying with legal obligations, or ensuring user safety. We implement security measures to protect your data.
privacyPolicy.txt9: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also opt-out of certain data collection practices. Contact us if you have any privacy concerns.
privacyPolicy.txt11: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We encourage you to review it periodically for any changes. Continued use of our services after updates constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
privacyPolicy.txt13: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@buezapp.com.

terms.txt1: Welcome to BUEZ, a platform operated by Buez Solution that connects users who need help with daily tasks to individuals willing to provide assistance in exchange for compensation. By accessing or using the BUEZ mobile application (the 'App') or any related services (collectively, the 'Service'), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions ('Terms'). If you do not agree, you must not use the Service.
terms.txt3: You must be at least 18 years old to use BUEZ. By registering, you confirm that you have the legal capacity to enter into this agreement. BUEZ reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
terms.txt5: You must create an account to access and use the Service. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. BUEZ is not liable for any unauthorized access to your account.
terms.txt7: BUEZ operates on a subscription-based model. Users must subscribe to access and post requests. Subscription fees are charged monthly and will continue until canceled by the user. Payments are processed through third-party payment providers.
terms.txt9: Users may post requests for assistance, specifying compensation and task details. Compensation is handled directly between the requestor and the helper, and BUEZ does not guarantee or process payments between users.
terms.txt11: Users must not post misleading, harmful, or offensive content, use the platform for illegal activities, or attempt to hack or disrupt the platform’s functionality.
terms.txt13: BUEZ is a facilitator and is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the Service. BUEZ does not guarantee the quality, reliability, or safety of services provided by users.
terms.txt15: For questions or support, please contact us at info@buezapp.com

faqs.txt2: Find answers to frequently asked questions
faqs.txt4: Our support team is here to assist you

questions.a1: BUEZ is a community-driven mobile application that connects people who need help with daily tasks to those willing to provide assistance in exchange for compensation or other benefits.
questions.a2: Users can post tasks they need help with, and others can browse and accept these requests. The platform facilitates communication and task completion through a secure messaging system.
questions.q3: Is BUEZ available in my area?
questions.a3: BUEZ shows requests within a 100 km radius of your location. You can see nearby requests and apply a location filter in the app.
questions.q4: What types of tasks can I post on BUEZ?
questions.a4: You can post various daily tasks including cleaning, moving, gardening and others with custom title.

questions.q1: Do I need a subscription to use BUEZ?
questions.a1: Yes, BUEZ operates on a subscription-based model. You need an active subscription to browse and post requests. However, you can register and create an account with a 14-day free trial.
questions.q2: How much does BUEZ subscription cost?
questions.a2: BUEZ offers a monthly subscription plan at $12.99. You can start with a 14-day free trial to explore all features.
questions.a3: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through the app settings. You'll maintain access until the end of your billing period.
questions.q4: What happens if I don't subscribe?
questions.a4: Without an active subscription, you can still create an account but won't be able to browse requests or post your own tasks.

questions.q1: How do I post a request for help?
questions.a1: Go to the 'Post Request' section, select your task type, add description, location, and compensation details. You can also upload photos to better explain your task.
questions.a2: You can offer monetary compensation or other benefits like gift cards, movie tickets, or any mutually agreed-upon reward.
questions.q3: Can I cancel a request after posting it?
questions.a3: Yes, you can cancel your active requests at any time from the 'My Requests' section.
questions.q4: How do I accept a task?
questions.a4: Browse available requests in the 'Home' section, view task details, and tap 'Accept Task' if you're interested in helping.
questions.q5: Can I cancel a task I've accepted?
questions.a5: Yes, you can cancel accepted tasks, though we encourage communicating with the requester first to avoid inconvenience.

questions.a1: Compensation is arranged directly between the requester and helper. BUEZ facilitates the connection but doesn't process payments between users.
questions.q2: When do I get paid for completed tasks?
questions.a2: Payment timing and method are agreed upon between you and the requester. We recommend discussing payment details before starting the task.
questions.q3: What if there's a dispute about payment?
questions.a3: BUEZ encourages clear communication about compensation before task acceptance. While we don't mediate payment disputes, we provide a review system to maintain community trust.

questions.a1: Yes, we prioritize user safety through review systems, and secure messaging. However, we always recommend meeting in public places for first-time interactions.
questions.a2: Yes, after task completion, you can leave reviews and ratings, helping build a trustworthy community.
questions.q3: What should I do if I have a bad experience?
questions.a3: You can report any concerns through our support system. We take community guidelines seriously and may suspend accounts that violate our terms.
questions.q4: How does the messaging system work?
questions.a4: Our built-in messaging allows private communication between requesters and helpers. This helps discuss task details, compensation, and coordination safely within the app.

questions.q1: How do I reset my password?
questions.a1: Use the 'Forgot Password' feature on the login screen. We'll send a reset link to your registered email address.
questions.q2: Can I change my profile information?
questions.a2: Yes, you can update your name, biography, and other profile details in the 'Edit Profile' section.
questions.q3: What if the app isn't working properly?
questions.a3: Try restarting the app or your device. If issues persist, contact our support team through the app's help section.
questions.a4: You can customize your notification preferences in the Settings section to control what alerts you receive.

questions.q1: How does the 14-day free trial work?
questions.a1: New users get full access to all BUEZ features for 14 days completely free. No credit card required upfront.
questions.q2: Will I be charged after the free trial?
questions.a2: If you don't cancel before the trial ends, your subscription will automatically continue at the monthly rate of $12.99.
questions.q3: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.a3: Go to Settings → Cancel Subscription. You'll maintain access until the end of your current billing period.
questions.a4: Subscription fees are non-refundable, but you can cancel anytime to prevent future charges.
